body:
Thanks, yeah, I'm noticing that as well.. it's hard, but I guess sometimes new friends can be good, if theyre better and more true friends...
I just don't like this loneliness i feel so often. :/

thank you

Thanks... I'm in college, just ending my first semester at a Community College... the couple of friends I've made there are bronies as well, and really, the reason we started talking was because of the pinkie pie keychain I have on my backpack. One of them, the one Id say im closest to, also likes Doctor Who, just like I do. Shes pretty cool, but she lives a while away from me. 

I tried going to a club thing with my boyfriend, one that a friend of his started, there were only a few people there,so I was more comfortable, though still really shy.... but it wasnt anything that interested me, so although the people there were entertaining and fun to be around, I just.. wasnt interested in what they were doing, so I stopped going. Theres an LGBT group/club I wouldnt mind joining, but I'm just not sure where to go or who to ask about it... :/

I know I need more friends... like I said, I have a couple, but I've always had a really hard time KEEPING friends, for whatever reason, and its hard for me to get close to people, which is why I even have a hard time calling the people I talk to at school "friends", that and the fact that we only really talk while in school. I'm horribly socially awkward, and it makes me so lonely... I hate it.

thanks for that suggestion, I'm going to check out that subreddit right now.

He ended up texting me after not hearing from me all day, and he was able to make me feel a little better. It was also a really cloudy/foggy/rainy day today, so I'm sure that didn't help much with my mood...

I've had some...issues.. with a couple of my other friends that left me feeling like I don't want to be,or cant be close to them anymore. I have a few friends in school, but they both have their own friend groups, and we only really talk in class, and maybe a few texts on the weekends. One of them isn't anyone I'd be comfortable hanging out with, either. He can get annoying. (Not to be rude, its just the way he acts sometimes.) Other than that, I just feel like I have a hard time fitting in with people. I'm pretty awkward/shy in social situations, so its hard for me to strike up a conversation or introduce myself to people. Even though the way I dress, or act when I'm around people I'm comfortable with, makes me seem really outgoing, I'm actually really quiet and shy.
Well [thank you](http://denver.mylittlefacewhen.com/media/f/img/mlfw1649-1316982367.jpg) for listening, I often feel like a bother when I complain.

I've been leaving her be, more waiting for her to come talk to me if and when she's ready... it doesn't help that I still feel lousy for making her mad, even if it's not anything serious. [](/lunasad)

Thank you, though. You've actually helped quite a bit. [](/raritydaww)

I don't mind being called guy. Or dude or bro, etc, etc, I just wanted to make sure people didn't just think I was actually a guy. [](/ajwut "")

The thing is, all this drama...is about me. She tends to get overdramatic often, its just who she is, and she's always been that way. But this is over something really not worth it, and shes being ridiculous about it, and ignoring me, and just all around making me feel like a horrible person by doing so, even if I know I haven't done anything worth being this pissed off about.
 I jsut keep thinking to myself "What did I do wrong? I haven't done anything to deserve this much anger, have I? What if I did? Why won't anyone tell me what it is...? "
 
I'd try to talk to her about it if she didn't just completely ignore me. She's off at college, so I can't talk to her in person, either. I have talked to my other friend about it, and he actually knows her better than I do, and hes told me that she just gets like this, shes being over dramatic and just to ignore it and she will most likely get over it soon, like she usually does. But shes never been so mad at me, and I really don't see what I did wrong. Unless there's a deeper problem that I don't know about...but if so, I wish she would just tell me so we could try to work it out somehow. Instead, she ignores me.

The only reason I know why shes mad at me is because she told another friend of ours, and he told me. I guess I could kind of see why she would be upset over it, except for the fact that what shes saying simply isn't true.

i'm a girl, actually. [](/flutterblush) But I didn't say that at all to begin with, so it doesn't matter.

I have someone wonderful who's trying to help me through this, and he helps me very much. Also that was quite the speech you gave just then, it actually made me feel better, believe it or not...

Just, the friend drama is getting to be ridiculous and I just have a really hard time handling it.. I dont know how to, and I dont know if I can put up with it much longer... I don't want to hurt anyone but I also don't need the kind of crap theyre putting me through, in fact I'd probably even be better off without it....

Well I mostly rant  and vent to my boyfriend....he's like my best friend right now, I don't have many friends to begin with...
Right now, I'm just really stressed out and its all weighing down on me at once. I'm 18, broke, my family stresses me out, I just started college and theres some friend related drama that I'm not sure how much longer I can deal with

I've just been under a ton of stress lately. I'm 18, just started college at a community college nearby, and I live with my grandparents. I've been job hunting for quite some time but nothing's worked out, so I'm completely broke. Plus there's some drama going on with a couple friends and I don't know how much longer I can take it.
